stories.title: Intel beats Q3 2026 estimates, but the stock falls
stories.summary: Intel's Q3 2026 results beat analyst estimates, according to the earnings call transcript. The stock fell despite the beat. The transcript does not give a clear reason for the drop.
stories.whyItMatters: Intel is a bellwether chipmaker. A beat that still sends the stock down often points to a guidance or margin worry that matters to the wider chip sector.
